description: 10uF, 35V, radial aluminum electrolytic, 5x11mm body, 2mm lead spacing

evidence.note: Mouser Search API, 2026-09-30: exact match for ECA-1VM100 (Panasonic Industry), Mouser part 667-ECA-1VM100, description 'Aluminum Electrolytic Capacitors - Radial Leaded 10uF 35V'.
Mouser Search API, 2026-09-30: description states '35V'; matches the '1V' voltage code (35V) in Panasonic's M-A series type numbering.
Panasonic M-A series datasheet (fetched 2026-09-30), Characteristics list, 35V (1V) section: 10uF row - case size 5.0 x 11.0mm, lead space (straight) 2.0mm, part no. ECA1VM100( ).
Panasonic M-A series datasheet (fetched 2026-09-30), Characteristics list, 35V (1V) section: 10uF row - case size (diameter x L) 5.0 x 11.0mm.

why: Panasonic's M-A (ECA) series is a current, widely stocked general-purpose radial electrolytic family that also covers this board's 100uF, 220uF and 470uF/35V lines in the same body-size table, so one family is used across those values (docs/parts/sourcing-notes.md Lessons, 2026-09-30). This is the straight-lead, unformed part - the one whose lead spacing in the datasheet's dimension table (2.0mm) matches the footprint exactly; taped variants of this value would carry a different formed-lead pitch.
